bagPolicy.summary: You can bring a small personal item such as a purse. Backpacks, larger bags, oversized purses, cinch bags and sling bags are not allowed.
allowed: Small personal item such as a purse
bagPolicy.quote: Patrons are allowed to attend with a small personal item such as a purse. Backpacks and larger bags are NOT ALLOWED.

parking.summary: Paid garage parking and street parking are available throughout Downtown Boulder. For accessible parking, use the City of Boulder's interactive parking map.
parking.quote: Paid garage parking and street parking ... is provided throughout Downtown Boulder.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Boulder Theater. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The Boulder Theater has a main bar plus fresh salads and pizza slices from The Lounge. Outside food and drink are not allowed, and sealed water bottles are prohibited, though you can bring an empty water bottle without the lid.
allowed: Empty water bottle without the lid
concessions.quote: The Boulder Theater is equipped with a main bar and fresh salads & pizza slices from The Lounge.

accessibility.summary: For reserved seating shows, look for the designated accessible tickets when you buy online. For general admission shows, buy your GA tickets first, then email boxoffice@z2ent.com or call 303.786.7030 to arrange seating.
accessibility.quote: please purchase your GA tickets first and reach out to boxoffice@z2ent.com for more information or to arrange seating.

reEntry.summary: Boulder Theater hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: You can buy tickets in person at the Boulder Theater box office Wednesday to Friday 3pm to 7pm and Saturday 12pm to 5pm. Mobile tickets work through the TIXR app, but screenshots are not accepted. Shows are all ages unless stated, children 15 and under need an adult, and age-restricted shows require a current state-issued ID or passport.
ticketPickup.quote: You may also get tickets in-person at the Boulder Theater box office Wed-Fri 3pm-7pm and Saturday 12pm-5pm.

gates.summary: Boulder Theater hasn't published doors and entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
